params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} During the {{tip|lockout}} of '''Ambessa's''' {{tip|abilities}}, inputting an {{tt|attack or movement command|Default MB2/right click}} causes her to {{tip|dash}} to or {{tt|towards|If inputted outside of the maximum dash range, she will dash the maximum distance towards the target/location}} the target or location, respectively, after the lockout ends. This dash cannot pass through terrain.
'''''Ambessa''' {{tt|cannot dash|See notes}} while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.''
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Ambessa''' casts an ability, she generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Medarda Maxim'' after the ability's respective lockout for 4 seconds, refreshing with subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times. Basic attacks consume one stack each to become empowered.
params.description3: {{sbc|Medarda Maxim:}} '''Ambessa's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|75 '''bonus''' range}} and {{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|{{pplevel|5 to 25}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, which applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and restore {{sti|energy|{{as|{{pp|40 to 70|1;7;13}} energy}}}}.
params.speed: {{pp|770 to 950 for 4|1;6;11;16|formula=770 at level 1, then +60 every 5 levels thereafter}} + {{as|100% movement speed}}
params.notes:
* Stacks of ''Medarda Maxim'' are consumed {{tip|on-hit}}, so means of applying on-hit effects without attacking (eg. {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}) will consume them without dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} or restoring {{as|energy}}.{{bug}}
* ''Medarda Maxim'' stacks are granted the moment '''Ambessa''' is able to start her dash upon casting her abilities.
* If an Attack command has been queued during an ability lockout and both:
*# the player issues a Hold (default {{sbc|J}}) or Stop (default {{sbc|S}}) command, '''and'''
*# the acquired target is within '''Ambessa's''' {{sti|attack range}} after the end of the lockout
** then '''Ambessa's''' dash will cancel.
* If '''Ambessa''' is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} during an ability's lockout, any attack or movement commands inputted during the lockout will not be buffered to cast at the end of the lockout, even if the crowd control has worn off by the time she is able to move (and thus dash).
** This also applies vice versa where she has successfully buffered an inputted attack or movement command but is afterwards affected with the aforementioned crowd control types during the remaining lockout time. This causes the buffer to be cancelled and the dash to fail to trigger as a consequence.
** Attack commands will not be buffered to cast at the end of the lockout even while {{tip|ground|grounded}}.
* If multiple attack and movement commands are inputted during the lockout of an ability, the most recent one is used for the dash's targeting.
** If the most recent input is not an attack or movement command, the dash will not trigger.
*** In this case, the buffer for the previous attack/movement command was cancelled by a new non-attack/movement command such as an input for an ability cast.
* During ''Drakehound's Step'', a visual indicator is visible to '''Ambessa''' displaying the eventual dash's direction and destination location.
* The number of available attacks empowered by ''Medarda Maxim'' are visible as pips under '''Ambessa's''' [[health bar]], only visible to the player.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} During any of {{cis|Ambessa}} {{tip|ability}} {{tip|lockout|lockouts}}, the player may right-click to select a location or target to {{tip|dash}} toward after the lockout ends. An indicator appears on the ground denoting the direction and destination location.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Casting an ability generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Medarda Maxim'' for a few seconds, up to 3 stacks. Basic attacks consume one stack to become empowered.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Medarda Maxim:}} '''Ambessa's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} gains {{sti|range}}, {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and restores {{sti|energy|{{as|energy}}}}.

params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}}, at the end of which she slashes with her twin drakehounds in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage is {{ccs|doubled|physical}} against enemies hit by the outer edge.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending, and '''Ambessa''' will perform the dash after her slash completes.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|40/2 to 120/2}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4/2 to 6/2}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Increased Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4 to 6}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
params.description2: If this hits at least one enemy, '''Ambessa''' can cast ''{{ai|Sundering Slam|Ambessa}}'' within the next 4 seconds.
params.description3: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Cunning Sweep'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} and the damage based on their health ratio is capped at {{pplevel|100 to 300}}.
params.notes:
* ''Cunning Sweep'' will slash from wherever '''Ambessa''' is at the end of the lockout.
** If her facing direction changes before the lockout completes, the slash will be performed towards the new direction.

params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' braces herself for up to {{fd|0.5}} seconds, during which in the first {{fd|0.225}} seconds she is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. After '''Ambessa''' finishes bracing, she smashes the ground beneath her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.25}} seconds of the lockout ending.
params.description2: Additionally, '''Ambessa''' {{tip|shield|shields}} herself at the time of cast for {{pplevel|50 to 320}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. If the shield mitigates any amount of damage taken from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}}, or {{tip|turret|turrets}} before '''Ambessa''' smashes the ground, ''Repudiation's'' damage is increased by 50%.
params.description3: '''''Ambessa''' will smash the ground at the end of {{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}} dash if she would finish bracing during it, and otherwise always smashes the ground from wherever she is at the end of the bracing time.''
params.notes:
* ''Repudiation's'' bracing time is unaffected by the initiation of ''{{ai|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash.
** '''Ambessa''' will smash the ground from wherever she is at the end of the bracing time even if the dash ends or completes its travel before the brace is finished.
*** She will remain in place until the brace is finished in this case.
*** If the brace would however finish during the dash, due to the specific timing of the dash's initiation, '''Ambessa''' will smash the ground at the end of the dash instead.
**** This would apply in cases where the dash is initiated shortly before the bracing is finished.
* ''Repudiation's'' shield buff and shield health on the health bar UI are not granted to and displayed on the caster on-cast, but rather only after a very short, inconsistent delay from the time of cast.{{bug}}
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Ambessa''' is locked out:

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ambessa''' gains {{sti|{{as|armor penetration}}}} and {{tip|heals}} herself for a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} she deals to enemies with her active abilities. The healing effectiveness is reduced to 25% against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Armor Penetration|{{ap|10 to 30}}%}}
{{st|Healing Percentage|{{ap|15 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 50% life steal)}}|Reduced Healing Percentage|{{ap|15*0.25 to 20*0.25}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% life steal)}}}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' prepares a strike in a line in the target direction, then {{tip|blinks}} behind the farthest enemy champion within the area and seizes them. If she {{tt|successfully|See notes}} seizes the target, '''Ambessa''' {{tip|attach|attaches}} them to herself and {{tip|suppression|suppresses}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds. While the target is suppressed, they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and '''Ambessa''' picks them up off the ground before crashing them back down, afterwards dealing {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.4}} seconds.
params.description3: '''''Ambessa''' is {{tip|displacement immune}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} during the cast time and while the target is suppressed. {{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}} dash may be buffered during the cast time or lockout, as well as initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending.''
params.notes:
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} may linger for up to an additional {{fd|0.1}} seconds after the suppression ends due to fuzziness.{{bug|2}}
* ''Public Execution's'' attachment depends on the application of the {{tip|suppression}}; if the suppression is not applied, neither is the attachment. Similarly, if the suppression is removed, so is the attachment.
** If the target resists the suppression by being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, {{tip|displacement immune}}, or having a {{tip|spell shield}}, '''Ambessa''' will not attach them to herself.
*** She will be unable to apply the damage and stun in this case since the suppression was not applied in the first place.
*** She will still {{tip|blink}} to the target in this case.
** If the target removes the suppression by any means, including with an applicable {{tip|cleanse}} effect or {{tip|dispel}}, they will instantly detach themselves from '''Ambessa''', which causes the ability to cancel immediately.
*** She will fail to apply the damage and stun to the target since the suppression was removed from them early in this case.
*** Her lockout and displacement immunity also ends prematurely in this case.
* The target is attached to '''Ambessa''' a small distance in front of her.
* '''Ambessa''' attaches the target to herself a second time, before detaching them at the end of the suppression.
* If '''Ambessa''' would blink inside the {{sti|attack range}} of an enemy {{tip|turret}}, including the [[Nexus Obelisk]], ''Public Execution'' will instead attempt to position her outside of it.
* '''Ambessa''' will {{tip|sight|reveal}} herself during the cast time if there is an enemy champion nearby.
* '''Ambessa''' will search for enemies in the direction she is facing at the end of cast time.
** This direction can be changed by {{cai|Encore|Seraphine}}.{{bug}}
* If '''Ambessa''' successfully seizes a target, any regular movement orders issued before doing so are discarded before the lockout ends.
** This does not affect movement orders issued during the lockout.
* '''Ambessa''' is also special-cased to be immune to {{tip|polymorph|polymorphs}} while she is {{tip|displacement immune}}.
* ''Public Execution'' will trigger a stack of {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}} for the suppression application and the damage dealt.
* ''Public Execution'' will '''not''' queue {{si|Flash}} if '''Ambessa''' attempts to use the summoner spell during the cast time.{{bug|2}}
